_note: Routing corpus of record for skills-studio — the skill LIFECYCLE tool (author / edit / optimize / score / critique / eval / promote a SKILL). Positives span the invocation families (imperative author, edit/optimize, score/critique/eval, diagnostic 'is this skill ready', indirect-paraphrase). Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from NAMED siblings that share skill-authoring vocabulary: skills-refactor (rename/merge/retire/split + rewire an EXISTING skill across a library — a structural move, not authoring or grading content), meta-app-scaffold (scaffold an apps/{name}/ reference-app FOUNDATION), plugin-decomposer (grade a PLUGIN bundle/manifest, not a skill), meta-expert-author + meta-theory-author (author a [domain]-expert KNOWLEDGE skill from waves of sources). Each negative belongs to one named sibling and uses ITS vocabulary. routing-eval measures LEXICAL overlap only — a paraphrase positive may miss; that is a proxy limit, not a defect.
